verdict.rationale: Unit's docs confirm it operates as middleware sitting between founders and underlying 'bank partners' (with FBO account structures and Federal Reserve access on behalf of banks), which does answer the general sponsor-model question, but there is no naming of specific partner banks nor any disclosure of what happens to customer funds/accounts if Unit itself fails or a bank exits the program. missing for 10: named partner bank identities, explicit failure/wind-down or FDIC pass-through insurance disclosure, and independent corroboration of these claims.
